title: Finite construction: exact two-helper k8 gauges save 576 scalar primitives
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Scaling L251 and L427 saves 576 scalar primitives per complex invocation in each orientation. This is optimal among dyadic gauges on at most two of the 237 eligible helpers, with ADD topology and existing SCALEs fixed. Each pair's cost is affine between vertical, horizontal and diagonal break lines. Boundary charges make it coercive; unit discounts lower boundary values. A minimum therefore occurs at an integral intersection. Independent integer-grid enumeration confirms every pair minimum. Exact replay checks all 712 input columns. Native hosting remains unchecked; no new kappa is claimed. Hanson Sun, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, credits @woklerx's PR1161, Sagar Thakrar's lowerer and the retained supplier lineage.


| Orientation | Baseline | Candidate | Scalar primitives saved |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Forward | 149002 | 148426 | 576 |
| Backward | 149018 | 148442 | 576 |

Status: **finite scalar construction and scoped two-helper optimum**. Paid profiles unchanged. Excluded: other helper interfaces, three or more scaled helpers, phase-varying gauges, changed original SCALEs, native/hosted admission, global invoice, new κ.

## Task and overlap

- Base: `1b59b624d21924f8e3537cdc1ac52d3be6eda2fe`.
- Seed: **25**, OS randomness; complex-supplier track.
- Task card: `research/k8-pair-dyadic-seed25/CLAIM.json`.
- PR #1161, `d210969d3158a1e6c505e41f67dd84e555c88564`: single-helper predecessor; its engine, proof and provenance retained unchanged. New scope: all 27,966 pairs among 237 cold/FULL, unwrapped, no-COPY/clear helpers, with both exponents in Z. Shared ADD interactions included.
- PR #1170: existing stage-SCALE consolidation; no composition claim.
- PR #1064: local factory source-scale predecessor; different whole-provider domain.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -B research/k8-pair-dyadic-seed25/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/k8-pair-dyadic-seed25/independent.py
python3 -I -O -B research/k8-pair-dyadic-seed25/test_package.py
```

- Exact all-column baseline/candidate endpoints; 735,975 vertices per orientation.
- Independent literal-lowerer pricing: every pair minimum; 19,162,332 interacting-pair grid evaluations; six exact dirty-state primitive replays.
- Sixteen rejection controls; actual source/program/certificate corruption; optimized offline relocation; gzip-header variation accepted by canonical payload equality.
- Local 52/68-bit positive envelopes; inherited 192-bit charge retained.
- Selected-record integrity and Ruff pass. Full native/global admission, cold replay, hosted CI and Lean unrun.
- Evidence: `CERTIFICATE.json`, `PAIR-CENSUS.json.gz`, `PROGRAMS.json.gz`, `SOURCES.json`, `VALIDATION.json`.
